[Skip to main content](https://www.trustradius.com/reviews/open-dental-software-2021-10-05-09-06-04#content) ### [Use Cases and Deployment Scope](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=product-usage\#reviews) Open Dental \[Software\] is a vital tool to our office and we use it to handle every aspect of our patient care. It's convenient in that it allows us to combine staff and patient schedules with patient records, billing and personal information. At the front desk, we can view patient account balances/payments, upcoming procedures, x-rays and provider notes, which allows us to quickly answer patient questions and provide excellent customer service. Open Dental's customer service is excellent and provides support that allows us to customize the software to our individual practice's needs. Edit ### [Pros and Cons](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=pros-and-cons\#reviews) #### Pros - Provider scheduling - Billing - Customer support - Internal reports #### Cons - Open Dental \[Software\] has issues when users try to open more than one window at a time. - There is no way to copy/paste provider schedules, so you have to schedule each day individually. Edit ProsEdit Cons Edit ### [Most Important Features](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=most-important-features-3-4-21\#reviews) - Affordability - Great customer service - Ease of use Edit ### [Return on Investment](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=operational-benefits\#reviews) - Streamlining billing, scheduling, and record keeping into one program makes it easier to onboard new staff as they only have to learn to use one software. - Having reports available in Open Dental \[Software\] make it easy to track insurance claims, income, and provider performance. Edit ### [Key Insights](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=quick-pulse\#reviews) #### Do you think Open Dental Software delivers good value for the price? Yes #### Are you happy with Open Dental Software's feature set? Yes #### Did Open Dental Software live up to sales and marketing promises? I wasn't involved with the selection/purchase process #### Did implementation of Open Dental Software go as expected? I wasn't involved with the implementation phase #### Would you buy Open Dental Software again? Yes Edit ### [Likelihood to Recommend](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=likelihood-to-recommend\#reviews) Open Dental \[Software\] is well suited to a practice that is willing to put time into customizing it to their needs. Since it is open-source software, it's not completely ready to use right out of the box, but comes with flexibility that other dental software lack. As such, you can make it work for whatever you need for your individual practice. If you're not super tech-savvy, they have a team that will help you with these customizations at a reasonable cost. Edit ### [Users and Roles](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=number-of-users\#reviews) **25** - Open Dental \[Software\] combines scheduling, billing, and patient records into one software, so everyone in the practice uses Open Dental \[Software\] from the front desk to the dental assistants to the doctors themselves. Edit ### [Support Headcount Required](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=ongoing-support-requirement\#reviews) Open Dental's customer service team provides all of the support necessary. If there is something that we want the software to do, we just reach out and they assist us in setting up that function. Open Dental \[Software\] also works with our IT/security provider so that we do not have to hire an in-house tech person to keep the tech side up and running. Edit ### [Business Processes Supported](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=business-processes\#reviews) - Scheduling - Billing - Patient records - Internal reports - Insurance claim tracking Edit ### [Future Planned Uses](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=future-uses\#reviews) - Setting up an online patient portal Edit ### [Likelihood to Renew](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=likelihood-to-renew\#reviews) 10 Our practice functions well using Open Dental \[Software\] and it's a very affordable option. So long as the customer service remains excellent and the price stays competitive, we have no reason to go through the hassle of changing software. Edit ### [Products Replaced](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=previous-software-package\#reviews) Not Sure Edit ### [Key Differentiators](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=decision-factors\#reviews) - Price - Product Features - Product Usability Edit ### [Implementation Details / Implementation Partner](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=type-of-implementation\#reviews) - Don't know Edit ### [Training Types Used](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=types-of-training\#reviews) - no training Edit ### [In-Person Training](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=in-person-training-rating\#reviews) Edit ### [Online Training](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=online-training-rating\#reviews) Edit ### [Support Rating](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=support-rating\#reviews) 10 Open Dental's customer support team has gone above and beyond for us. There was a 2-3 month period where we couldn't go more than 5 minutes without the software crashing - which was an issue with our server and not with their product. Despite it being our issue, the customer service team remained in constant contact with us and with our IT support company until the issue was resolved. Each time we have used it, the fee has been well worth it and the support has been excellent. Edit ### [Usability](https://www.trustradius.com/products/open-dental-software/reviews?qs=product-usability\#reviews) 7 Open Dental \[Software\] works great....until you try to open multiple windows. This is the one feature that needs serious improvement with the product. I've had to force quit/terminate the software more times than I can count because it froze when I tried to open up a second window to complete a task. Other than this one issue, it's a very usable product.
